text:
sasha: FYI the eu-west JIT keystore proxy canary started spiking outbound to audit-exporter; NAT QPS saturated and GPU warm-pool joins are failing.
mira: alerted. when did that start?
sasha: canary at 08:03 UTC, ~220 nodes, each doing multiple keystore fetches during startup. exporter QPS jumped and NAT soft-limit hit.
raj: explains warm-pool drop. proxy did per-session fetches and bypassed node cache.
lee: why was cache bypassed?
sasha: new client lib defaulted to cache=false to avoid stale keys after rotation. rotations are rare; we can TTL for warmup.
mira: mitigation options: rollback canary, flip client flag to cache 30s, sample audit events (1/10), or open EU-only allowlist to avoid shared NAT queue.
raj: flip flag + sampling first. smaller blast radius. I'll open a temp SG allowlist as backup.
ops-bot: runbook task created: /runbooks/keystore-eject-2025-01
sasha: PR ready: set cache_ttl=30s for warmup and audit_sample_rate=0.1; tested in staging.
lee: deploy EU canary only with smoke checks. rolling now.
raj: temp SG command (revoke in 2h):
`aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.32.0.0/22`
infra-bot: provisional extra egress ~310GB -> est $22, billing line-item pending.
mira: add exporter buffering to batch writes every 10s to drop QPS.
sasha: dashboards updated: keystore.qps, nat.conn, egress.bytes, warmpool.join_rate. lowered alerts while we monitor.
lee: canary looks good, keystore qps back to normal, warm-pool fill recovering.
mira: if confirmed, add infra-safety: default 30s cache for JIT warmup + sampling policy and RFC to eng-platform docs.
raj: capture cost delta for postmortem; tagging infra-billing.
ops-bot: muted keystore qps alert (eu-west) for 30m by ops on-call.
infra-bot: final billing note: provisional extra egress ~245GB -> est $18, subject to cloud invoice.
sasha: thanks all, keeping watch.
mira: :thumbsup:
